root_idea.summary: The main lexical orientation is deliberate, often concealed maneuvering that diverts another through stratagem, deception, or cunning. A separate lexical branch concerns the thickness or fleshiness of the legs.
root_idea.development: The principal branch extends across the act of plotting, the resulting scheme or plot, its active agent, reciprocal forms, and the Quranic usage of divine counteraction or requital. The moral value of mكر varies with its object, while the leg-related branch is treated as lexically distinct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb with an independent verbal entry.
Quran-attested active participle, normalized from the supplied plural form to its singular citation form.
Quran-attested verbal noun with an independent nominal entry.

senses.definition: To employ a covert stratagem, deception, or artifice to divert another from what they intend; to plot or scheme.
senses.usage_conditions: The action may be praiseworthy or blameworthy according to its object. With بِ, the construction means to deceive, beguile, or circumvent someone; the verb may also be used for plotting a thing.

senses.definition: Of God, to counter or requite opponents’ plotting, including by granting them respite and worldly enablement until punishment overtakes them.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the specialized Quranic construction مَكَرَ اللهُ. Its transmitted explanations include divine counteraction or requital and the gradual taking of those who are allowed to prosper while their wrongdoing brings about their punishment.

senses.definition: One who practices mكر: a plotter or deviser of a covert stratagem.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic plural مَاكِرِينَ is used of God as the superior counter-planner against hostile plotting.

senses.definition: A covert stratagem, deception, or artful scheme used to divert or circumvent another; a plot or machination.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun may denote the plotting itself or the resulting plan. Its moral value depends on the object and purpose of the scheme.

senses.definition: God’s counteraction or requital of plotting; also His granting of respite and worldly enablement that leads the wrongdoer toward punishment.
senses.usage_conditions: This is the Quranic expression مَكْرُ اللهِ and related constructions referring to divine action against plotters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To manage affairs with deliberation, craft, and policy, employing stratagem, especially in warfare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This branch emphasizes skilled or cunning management and does not inherently require deception or a harmful objective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practice mutual deceit, guile, or circumvention with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses reciprocal participation in the mكر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practice mutual deceit, guile, or circumvention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI expresses reciprocal or mutual engagement in the action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A habitual or frequent practitioner of deceit, guile, or cunning; a habitual trickster.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These adjectival forms intensify the agentive meaning by indicating repeated or frequent practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman described as having thick, fleshy, or robust legs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate bodily lexical branch, explicitly used in the phrase describing the two legs.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Core covert-stratagem and deliberate policy branches are represented.
The بِ construction and plotting-a-thing usage are covered under the main Quranic verb sense.
The specialized policy and stratagem-in-war branch is represented classically.
Divine counteraction, requital, respite, and gradual taking are represented under the verb and noun.
The synonymic مَكَرَ بِهِ construction is covered under the Quranic verb sense.
The reciprocal Form III meaning is represented separately.
Pointer-only entry referring back to Form I.
The reciprocal Form VI meaning is represented separately.
The active-agent adjective and its frequent-practice adjectival forms are represented.
The compact noun gloss is covered by the Quranic verbal-noun sense.

cautions: Divine مكر has several transmitted explanations, including counteraction or requital and the granting of respite with worldly enablement; it should not be reduced mechanically to ordinary human deception.
The bodily sense concerning thick or fleshy legs is lexically separate from the main deception-and-stratagem branch.
